% A test for tex8web's title in a class without \maketitle, as a letter's:
% it builds without errors or warnings, and \title still gives the page's
% title.
\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter\AtBeginDocument{\let\maketitle\@undefined}\makeatother
\title{Without a maketitle}
\begin{document}
Some text.
\end{document}
